title: Trump and Canada’s Carney Seem to Make Progress on a Tariff Deal, but Questions Linger
summary_full: After a deadline extension, the latest U.S. tariff threats seemed headed toward resolution on Wednesday, but questions lingered about what Canada would give up, and what it would get in exchange.
